6a6acfb64d8f7b3935a30e22 description:
Hello, soldier! I heard you're trying to get a friend out of a tight spot. Jaeger told me a bit, though he didn't go into much detail.

I plan to send some of my men to Ground Zero. They'll take a look at whatever was left behind and see if they find anything useful. But obviously, I won't send them in while the area is still swarming with Scavs and PMCs, right?

I want you to clear the area before we send the team in. Take care of anyone who might interfere with the operation and let me know when you're done.

Good luck, soldier.
6a6acfb64d8f7b3935a30e22 successMessageT: Is the area secure? Then let's proceed. Thank you!
6a6ad307b056d89f85a30e2f description:
Hey there, soldier!

My people scoured that TerraGroup building in Ground Zero and found some interesting things. Nothing that seems very important to your situation, so I'll probably sell most of it.

But they also found a clue that might interest you. Apparently, an unidentified group was guarding documents belonging to someone in a bunker near the bridge on Woods.

Maybe it's the stuff you're looking for. Considering everything we know so far, this is probably our best lead.

Head over there, take a look in the bunker and see what you can find. Let me know when you're done, soldier.
6a6ad307b056d89f85a30e2f successMessageT: We're moving quite fast. Very good.
